purpose: S10-B 批量语义批改：每家公司一份报告、一次请求、分开核验
method: AI judge (qwen-plus structured output)，非人工判定

metric_boundary.may_be_called: N 条人工核验标准答案的 AI 判定明细（可复核、附逐字证据句）
metric_boundary.must_not_be_called: 准确率 / 幻觉率 / 引用可追溯率 / p95 / 成本单价
reasons: judge 是 AI 判定，未经人工抽检一致率校准；人出题、AI 批卷仍非人工评分
not_mentioned 不等于系统答错：标准答案与报告栏目可能本来就不对应
golden 的引用层（最终 URL 是否支撑事实）未核验，不能算引用类指标
样本量小，且 5 家公司不是随机抽样，不能外推成「系统准确率」

judgements.expected_text: Figma 于 2025 年 7 月 31 日在纽交所开始交易，代码 FIG，IPO 发行价 33 美元/股
evidence_quotes: Figma completed its IPO in July 2025. [11]
judgements.reason: The report states Figma completed its IPO in July 2025 and its stock symbol is FIG, but does not specify the date July 31, 2025 or the IPO price of $33/share; however, since the claim specifies 'July 31, 2025' and '33 USD/share' — both absent — and the report only says 'July 2025', the precise claim is not supported; yet verdict is 'refuted' only if contradicted — and it is not contradicted. Wait: re-evaluate — the claim says '2025年7月31日', report says 'July 2025'. That is *not contradictory*: July 31 falls within July 2025. But the claim also specifies 'IPO发行价 33 美元/股' — the report gives no IPO price at all. So for the full claim (date + price), the report provides partial info but omits the price and exact date. Per rules: 'not_mentioned' if 'only zero散 information不足以确认'. Since price is missing and exact date is not confirmed (only month/year), the full claim is not confirmed. So verdict is 'not_mentioned'. Correction: initial 'refuted' was wrong — no contradiction exists. Therefore correct verdict is 'not_mentioned'.
